falseSynonyms.zh: 太一般、強度較低 一般「不好」，而 dreadful 通常表示非常糟或非常令人不快。
falseSynonyms.point: The meal was bad; the meal was dreadful expresses much stronger disapproval.

falseSynonyms.zh: 差，但通常較弱 常評價品質、表現或條件不佳，但未必達到 dreadful 的強度。
falseSynonyms.point: Poor service is unsatisfactory; dreadful service is extremely bad.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人不愉快不等於糟透 偏不舒服／不討喜，通常弱於 dreadful。
falseSynonyms.point: An unpleasant journey is uncomfortable; a dreadful journey may be far worse.

falseSynonyms.zh: 偏恐懼 強調令人害怕，而 dreadful 很多時只是 very bad。
falseSynonyms.point: A scary film frightens you; dreadful food may simply taste very bad.

falseSynonyms.zh: 嚴重不等於 dreadful 描述重要／嚴重程度，但沒有 dreadful 的強烈負面評價。
falseSynonyms.point: A serious problem may be important; a dreadful situation is strongly negative.

falseSynonyms.zh: 令人失望但較弱 表示未達期望，不一定糟到 dreadful。
falseSynonyms.point: A disappointing result may still be acceptable; an abysmal result is extremely poor.

falseSynonyms.zh: 厭惡感更具體 強調噁心／道德厭惡，只對部分 dreadful 語境成立。
falseSynonyms.point: A disgusting smell is revolting; dreadful weather is not normally disgusting.

falseSynonyms.zh: 危險不等於糟糕 指有造成傷害的風險；dreadful 可以很糟但完全不危險。
falseSynonyms.point: Dreadful service is not necessarily dangerous.
